rationale: Keeps the current best late-aligned decoder-skip scaffold, but trains with only the deepest recurrent tail block active until about 54% of the train budget, then switches to the full two-block tail recurrence. The hypothesis is that the skip-aligned decoder benefits from a less noisy early optimization path, while final evaluation/export stays unchanged on the full recurrent model.
title: Late-Aligned Decoder Skips With Tail-Recurrence Warm-In
